title: Rejewski ROE Consent Record (v1 — replay-log-embedded)
description: The consent record as it is embedded as the first entry of a run's replay log, per docs/roe-consent-flow.md v0.2 §3. This is the shape of the committed R010/R011 consent records. v1 is frozen for backward compatibility; the durable long-term-archive superset is schemas/roe-consent/v2.json. additionalProperties: false; every field required; draft 2020-12.

event.description: Consent outcome. A declined record is preserved as evidence of the refusal (roe-consent-flow.md §4).

run_id.description: Binds the record to every downstream replay-log entry. Committed samples use the run-label form (e.g. R011); a runtime-generated UUIDv4 is also accepted (roe-consent-flow.md §2).

tenant_id.description: Target tenant GUID. For self-test runs this MUST equal the G-1 locked sandbox tenant (76b87c33-6178-4ff9-94a7-164792c8e4c6).

operator_object_id.description: Entra ID object id of the signed-in operator; never UPN or display name (ADR 0001 §8).

techniques.description: ATT&CK technique IDs as confirmed at the prompt.

expected_duration_seconds.description: Upper bound; the run aborts if it exceeds 2x this value (G-8 alignment).

prompt_emitted_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp when the consent prompt was emitted.

confirmed_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp when the operator confirmed.
